Later, Fetho Hollmere won the amber mirror from Lutho at cards, fairly, and kept it. Eventually, Isnar Brackwood won the amber mirror from Conar Hollett at cards, fairly, and kept it. Finally, the eldest daughter of Nyvie Hollett won the amber mirror from Isnar Brackwood at cards, fairly, and kept it.
